question: Do the two 4-bit Unsloth Dynamic recipes the launcher accepts (UD-IQ4_XS, UD-Q4_K_XL) beat the IQ3_S reference on teacher-forced fidelity, and is the larger pack worth its bytes?
yardstick: quant_quality v1 set.ids.json, 4995 positions (999 x code/docs/english/multilingual/agent), teacher-forced, temperature 0, no sampling

gpu.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080
gpu.note: all arms run in a window with production stopped; the arms cannot run beside another resident engine on a 16 GB card

model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Unsloth GGUF, MoE 48 layers x 512 experts)
reference: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-IQ3_S - the incumbent production brain, ppl 4.057 on this set

notes.top1_and_kl_metric: top1 and kl are measured against the reference arm's argmax/distribution, so they measure agreement with a quant, not with the source model
notes.ppl_metric: ppl is the perplexity of the fixed text under each arm - absolute, not reference-relative
notes.mean_logp: mean log-probability of the true token per position, paired across arms on the same positions

paired_tests.method: exact two-sided McNemar on raw top-1 correctness, paired by position; mean logp paired on the same positions

qwen3.8_flash_next_ud_q3_k_xl.note: smaller than the launcher's servable range at the time; quality compared only

conclusions: IQ4_XS is better calibrated than both IQ3_S and the 33%-larger Q4_K_XL: lower ppl in all five segments, lower mean KL, half the p99 KL.
The top-1 difference is not statistically significant at 4995 positions (McNemar p 0.53 vs Q4_K_XL, 0.30 vs IQ3_S); the ppl/mean-logp difference is the robust signal.
Q4_K_XL, the largest pack, is the worst of the three on ppl, KL and p99, and on top-1 correctness - bytes are not a proxy for fidelity on this model.
The pack build's reported max |err| over converted tensors ranks these two arms the wrong way round (0.0286 for the winner, 0.0144 for the loser).
Decode cost of the +12.0% byte increase is not measured here; it decides adoption, not fidelity.

artifacts.window_script: quality_window.sh (production stopped by name, brain restored by trap on any exit)
